selection.rule: For every archetype pick its canonical GENERATE family (lowest tr-id) plus every REPAIR family (tr-26..tr-30). Build the ordered slot list of [repair x2] then [canonical generate x2, ascending tr-id], and assign a framework to each slot by round-robin over the framework order.
